alarms.action: Sets M290, lights fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25), aborts cycle to VENT (M205), and sets FAIL result (M211).
alarms.condition: Test pressure (14.50 kPa) not reached within 8.0 s (T21 done in FILL step M202)
alarms.name: Fill timeout

alarms.action: Latches M291, lights fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25), closes fill valve, holds vent valve (Y22) open, and aborts to VENT with FAIL result.
alarms.condition: Pack pressure PT-2001 exceeds 20.00 kPa (D100 > D123 / K2000)
alarms.name: Over-pressure

alarms.action: Drives M292, contributes to general fault M299 / beacon HL-2011 (Y25), inhibits cycle start, and holds clamp release / unclamp.
alarms.condition: PT-2001 reading below -5.00 kPa (D100 < K-500, wire break)
alarms.name: PT-2001 signal fault

alarms.action: Latches M293, lights fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25), aborts cycle to VENT with FAIL result.
alarms.condition: Supply air switch PS-2009 (X22) lost while station is busy (M200)
alarms.name: Supply air low

conflicts.parameter_sheet_says: 5.0 s (T22, changed from 3.0 s by MOC-2021-044)
conflicts.program_says: 5.0 s (R13: OUT T22 K50 on 100 ms timer = 5.0 s)
5.0 s (R21: OUT T200 K50 on FX5 100 ms base = 5.0 s, migrated from FX3 10 ms timer base without adjusting instruction)

interlocks.cause: Pallet sensor (ZS-2008 / X23) drops and returns while test is running (M200 is ON)
interlocks.effect: Must not restart sequence (prevented by ANI M200 in R8).

interlocks.cause: Clamp confirmed closed signal lost or clamp not confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20 lost or ZS-2002B / X21 made)
interlocks.effect: Fill valve (XV-2003 / Y21) cannot open / closes immediately.

interlocks.cause: Any active fault / E-stop lost (M299 ON) while busy (M200 ON)
interlocks.effect: Aborts cycle to VENT (M205), isolates fill (Y21 OFF), and sets FAIL (M211).

interlocks.cause: Pack pressure not below 1.00 kPa or PT-2001 signal fault (M292 ON) during vent
interlocks.effect: Clamp release inhibited; station holds in VENT step (M205) with vent valve held open.

interlocks.cause: Manual vent pushbutton (PB-2010 / X25) pressed in manual mode (ANI X2)
Station not at DONE step (M207 not active)
interlocks.effect: PASS (RS-2006 / Y23) and FAIL (RS-2007 / Y24) result signals to line controller inhibited.

steps.entry: Pallet arrives in test position (ZS-2008 rising edge / LDP X23) while cell in auto mode (X2), no ST20 fault active (ANI M299), and station idle (ANI M200).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20 made and ZS-2002B / X21 clear).
steps.name: START / CLAMP (M201)

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed closed from step M201.
steps.exit: PT-2001 reaches fill threshold (14.50 kPa / D100 >= D122) transitioning to STABILISE, or fill timeout (T21 8.0 s) / fault condition aborting to VENT.
steps.name: FILL (M202)

steps.entry: Fill pressure reached (PT-2001 >= 14.50 kPa / D100 >= D122).
steps.name: STABILISE (M203)

steps.exit: Test window timer elapsed (T23 done, 10.0 s).
steps.name: TEST (M204)

steps.entry: Test window complete (T23 done) or abort from active fault (M299 while busy).
steps.exit: Vent time elapsed (T200 done), pack pressure vented below 1.00 kPa (D100 < K100), and PT-2001 healthy (ANI M292).
steps.name: VENT (M205)

steps.entry: Vent conditions satisfied (T200 done, D100 < 1.00 kPa, ANI M292).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B / X21 made and ZS-2002A / X20 clear).
steps.name: UNCLAMP (M206)

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed open (X21 ON, X20 OFF).
steps.exit: Pallet departs from test position (ANI X23), returning station to idle.
steps.name: DONE / RESULT (M207)
